description: Illustrative FCC-ee Z-pole yield projection; edit these physics assumptions before toys.

sources.br_lb_to_lambda_gamma: User benchmark 1e-5; PDG central value about 7.1e-6: https://pdg.lbl.gov/2025/listings/rpp2025-list-lambdab-zero.pdf

notes: The 0.084 Z-pole production fraction is for all weakly decaying b baryons, not Lambda_b alone. The share=1 assumption is an upper-envelope proxy; replace it with a measured or simulated Lambda_b-specific fraction for a sensitivity claim.
Both forced EvtGen samples use phase-space decays and forced daughter branching ratios. Physical daughter branching fractions are applied here.
Offline thresholds are exploratory and are not applied in the stage-1 reconstruction.
